title: RESERVOIR ANNOUNCES PUBLISHING DEAL WITH MULTI-PLATINUM AND GRAMMY-WINNING HIP-HOP ICON T.I.
summary: Reservoir Media, Inc. (NASDAQ: RSVR, the "Company"), an award-winning independent music company, today announced a publishing deal with hip-hop icon T.I. Under the agreement, Reservoir will work alongside T.I. across his entire publishing catalog, spanning his back catalog and future works, including his new album, Kill the King, which debuted in the Top 10 on Billboard's Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums and Top Rap Albums charts.
